Illustrative_design_choice: One-step buyer approval for low-value PO; two-role approval above illustrative INR 100000 threshold
Rationale: Separates routine purchases from higher financial exposure; threshold requires finance approval
Validation_evidence: Test low and high value cases; confirm audit trail and segregation of duties
Mandarin_label_example: 采购订单 (cǎigòu dìngdān) / Purchase order

Illustrative_design_choice: Named owner for supplier, material, base unit and purchasing unit; duplicate check before activation
Rationale: Reduces duplicate records and ambiguous purchasing units
Validation_evidence: Required-field, duplicate-key and unit conversion checks

Illustrative_design_choice: Receipt references PO; quantity tolerance ±2% for review, not automatic acceptance; quality hold where needed
Rationale: Preserves traceability and prevents unchecked stock becoming available
Validation_evidence: PO-to-receipt match; over/under tolerance test; blocked-stock test

Illustrative_design_choice: Canonical units: KG, L, EA, CASE; conversion factors approved per material
Rationale: Avoids mixing purchasing, inventory and production quantities
Validation_evidence: Unit mapping and conversion sample; reject unknown codes

Illustrative_design_choice: Plant-level procurement type, lead time, lot-sizing rule, safety stock where approved, and planner ownership
Rationale: Makes planning proposals reflect supply source and replenishment constraints
Validation_evidence: Recalculate sample shortage with approved BOM, stock and lead time

Illustrative_design_choice: Versioned BOM for FG-CHUTNEY; approved operations/work center and effective dates
Rationale: Connects component demand to a traceable production sequence
Validation_evidence: BOM explosion for one planned batch; compare expected component quantities

Illustrative_design_choice: Planner reviews shortages and capacity before release; no auto-release in initial design
Rationale: Prevents infeasible orders and makes exception ownership explicit
Validation_evidence: Shortage case stays unreleased; feasible case can proceed after review

Illustrative_design_choice: Buyer, planner, receiver, approver roles; Chinese helper text adjacent to stable English ERP field names
Rationale: Supports access control and comprehension without changing technical identifiers
Validation_evidence: Role-based access check; bilingual reviewer signs off high-impact labels
